name: Family Residence Visa

requirements.blocker_text: The sponsor (a resident foreign worker) must earn at least KWD 800/month (raised from KWD 550 before 2022) to sponsor a spouse or children under 18; parents and siblings cannot be sponsored under this visa. Sponsors outside exempted professions (engineering, media, medicine, higher education) must additionally hold a university degree matching their Kuwait employment field. The requirement may be waived for children aged 0-5 when both parents already reside in Kuwait, subject to Director General approval.
requirements.fix_path: Meet the KWD 800/month salary threshold (or qualifying profession/degree match) before sponsoring dependents.

evidence_required.document: University degree matching employment field (non-exempt professions)

sources.title: Fragomen (global immigration law firm) -- Kuwait's Family Residence Visa: KWD 800/month minimum sponsor salary, spouse and under-18 children only (parents/siblings excluded), degree-matching requirement outside exempt professions, 3-year validity without work authorization, and the program's 2022 suspension and phased 2022-2024 reopening

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kuwait). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced to a global immigration law firm's client alert (tier 3), not a fetched Kuwaiti government page (Ministry of Interior/PACI pages returned 403 errors in this build, the same recurring pattern as this country's other routes). GENUINELY DISTINCTIVE, RECENT FINDING WORTH FLAGGING: this entire visa category was SUSPENDED in August 2022 and only reopened in stages -- young children (0-5) in December 2022, medical-staff families in September 2023, and a broad expansion to skilled foreign nationals generally effective 28 January 2024. This is a live illustration of how administratively fragile family-reunification access can be in the kafala-based Gulf labor-migration model: a policy lever the government can and did switch off entirely for over a year. study_rights set 'restricted' rather than 'full' since specific dependent school-enrollment rights were not detailed in the source reviewed; family_can_work set false since the visa explicitly does not grant work authorization to the dependent.
